status: preferred design approach selected by user
user_statement: This direction is much better and should be the preferred approach
scope: Preserve native Farm and Incan Terrace Farm artwork and add distinct, readable irrigation components.
requirements: Retain native field textures, parcel shapes, props, terrace walls and natural boundaries.
Use a few legible channels; preserve the existing aqueduct design.
Keep a continuous source connection with level or descending water routes.
Close exposed route ends within the field and join selected shared water connections.
Treat the earlier replacement-field mesh designs as historical studies.
approval_limits: Direction selection does not certify every generated detail or approve the final mesh, native conversion, terrain fit, runtime adjacency or in-game appearance.
supersedes: Replacement crop/terrain design approach in v1-v3; preserves previous artwork and approval history.
